newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 20 dead in heavy combat east of Bogota.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 dead in heavy combat east of Bogota.

text.p: At least 20 people have been killed in fighting between the army and leftist rebels in mountains 30 miles (50 km) east of Bogota and about 40 soldiers are missing in the combat zone, authorities said on Monday.

"Representatives of the International Committee of the Red Cross have been to part of the combat zone to pick up eight injured. They counted at least 20 dead," said Teddy Torbeaum, head of the Red Cross in Meta province.
Army commander Gen. Manuel Jose Bonett said earlier that an entire counterinsurgency unit of between 40 and 50 men was unaccounted for after radio contact was lost at noon Sunday.
Asked about a high army death toll at a news conference Bonett said "anything is possible."

An ICRC representative said the organisation had received an emergency call from members of the southern block of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) guerrilla group asking for it to help recover some wounded. Bonett said at least eight rebels had been killed in the area in the past week.

Torbeaum said it was unclear how many of the 20 dead were soldiers and added that peasants from three villages in the combat zone had fled to the nearest town, San Juanito. Town mayor Ramiro Jimenez told national radio the army had been carrying out an intense aerial bombardment of the area.
